कृष्टि॑ अयस्, f. pl. (once only sg. RV. iv, 42, 1) men, races of men (sometimes with the epithet मा॑नुषीस् [i, 59, 5 and vi, 18, 2] or ना॑हुषीस् [vi, 46, 7] or मानवी॑स् [AV. iii, 24, 3]; cf. चर्षणि॑; originally the word may have meant cultivated ground, then an inhabited land, next its inhabitants, and lastly any race of men; Indra and Agni have the N. रा॑जा or प॑तिः कृष्टीना॑म्; the term प॑ञ्च कृष्ट॑यस्, perhaps originally designating the five Āryan tribes of the Yadus, Turvaśas, Druhyus, Anus, and Pūrus, comprehends the whole human race, not only the Āryan tribes), RV.; AV.

कृष्णाङ्घ्रि mfn. having black legs Comm. on TPrāt.

कृष्णाचल m. ‘black mountain’, N. of the mountain Raivata (part of the western portion of the Vindhya chain; also one of the nine principal chains that separate the nine divisions or Varṣas of the known world), L.
कृष्णाजिन॑ n. the skin of the black antelope, AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; AitBr. &c.
कृष्णाजिन॑ (अस्), m. ‘covered with a skin of the black antelope’, N. of a man, and (आस्), m. pl. his descendants g. उपकादि and तिककितवादि, Kāś. on Pāṇ. v, 3, 82 and vi, 2, 165
कृष्णाजिन—ग्रीव॑ mfn. having a skin of the black antelope round the neck, ŚBr. iii.
कृष्णाजिनिन् mfn. covered with the skin of a black antelope, MBh. xiv, 2113.
कृष्णाञ्जन-गिरि m. N. of a mountain (cf. अञ्ज्˚), R. iii, 55, 5.
कृष्णाञ्जनी f. (= कालाञ्ज्˚) a kind of shrub, L.
कृष्णा॑ञ्जि mfn. having black marks, VS. xxiv, 4.
कृष्णात्रेय m. N. of a sage, Car.; Jyot.; ŚārṅgS.
कृष्णा॑ध्वन् mfn. having a black path (said of Agni), RV. ii, 4, 6; vi, 10, 4.
कृष्णा-नदी f. the Kistna river, L.
कृष्णानन्द m. N. of a scholiast
of the author of the Tantra-sāra
कृष्णानन्द—स्वामिन् m. N. of a man.
कृष्णान्तर n. the loadstone, Gal.
कृष्णाभा f. N. of a shrub, L.
कृष्णाभ्र n. dark talc, L.
कृष्णाभ्रक n. dark talc, L.
कृष्णामिष n. iron, L.
कृष्णामृत-तरंगिका f.
कृष्णामृत-महार्णव m. N. of two works.
कृष्णायस् n. black or crude iron, iron, VarBṛS.; Suśr.; ChUp. vi, 1, 6, Sch.
कृष्णायस n. id., ChUp.; MBh.; Suśr. (cf. कालाय्˚ and कार्ष्णाय्˚.)
कृष्णार्चन-विधि m. ‘rules for praising Kṛṣṇa’, N. of wk.
कृष्णार्चिस् m. ‘dark-flamed (through smoke)’, fire, L.
कृष्णार्जक m. = ˚ष्ण-मल्लिका, L.
कृष्णालंकार m. N. of a Comm.
कृष्णालु m. N. of a bulbous plant, L.
कृष्णाल्पक m. black Aloe wood, VarBṛS. lxxviii, 1, Sch.
कृष्णावतार m. an Avatār or incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, W.
कृष्णावदात mfn. black and white, W.
कृष्णाश्रय m. ‘devotion to Kṛṣṇa’, N. of a work.
कृष्णाश्रित mfn. devoted to or a votary of Kṛṣṇa, W.
कृष्णाष्टमि-रत m. (metrically for ˚मी-र्˚) ‘rejoicing at Kṛṣṇa's birthday (see कृष्ण-जन्माष्टमी)’, N. of Śiva, MBh. xiii, 14, 290.
कृष्णाष्टमी f. = ˚ष्ण-जन्माष्ट्˚, BhavP.; MatsyaP.
the eighth day in the dark half of any month, Kulārṇ.
कृष्णाहि m. = ˚ष्ण-भुजंग, Kathās. lvi, 127; Pañcad.
कृष्णाह्वय m. pl. N. of a school, Caraṇ.
कृष्णेक्षु m. a sort of sugarcane, L.
कृष्णैत॑ mfn. (Pāṇ. vi, 2, 3, Kāś.) spotted black, TS. v, vii.
कृष्णोदर m. ‘having a black belly’, a kind of snake, Suśr.
कृष्णोदर—शिरस् m. ‘having a black belly and a black head’, N. of a bird, Gal.
कृष्णोदुम्बरिका f. the tree Ficus oppositifolia (cf. काकोदुम्बर), L.
कृष्णोपनिषद् f. N. of an Up. (in praise of the god Kṛṣṇa, being part of the Gopālopaniṣad).
कृष्णोरग m. = कृष्ण-भुजंग, MBh.
कृष्णोऽस्य्-आखरेष्ठक mfn. (an Adhyāya or Anuvāka) beginning with the words कृ॑ष्णो ऽस्य् आखरे-ष्ठः॑. (TS. i, 1, 11, 1; VS. ii, 1) g. गोषद्-आदि.
कृष्णौजस् m. N. of an attendant in Skanda's retinue, MBh. ix, 2577.
कृष्णक m. (g. स्थूलादि) ‘blackish’, a kind of plant (perhaps black Sesamum), Kauś. 80
a shortened N. for Kṛṣṇājina, Pāṇ. v, 3, 82, Sch.
कृष्णिका f. black, black substance, Kād.; Hcar.
a kind of bird (= श्यामा), L.
black mustard (Sinapis ramosa), L.
कृष्णिका See कृष्णक.

कृष्ण॑ल n. rarely [Yājñ. i, 362] m. (g. सिध्मादि) the black berry of the plant Abrus precatorius used as a weight (the average weight being between one and two grains), Kāṭh.; TBr.; Mn.; Yājñ. Comm. on KātyŚr. &c.
a coin of the same weight, Mn.; Yājñ.
a piece of gold of the same weight, TS.; Kauś.; Nyāyam.
कृष्ण॑ला f. Abrus precatorius (a shrub bearing a small black and red berry = गुञ्जा, रक्तिका), L.
कृष्णलक अस् or अम्, m. n. ifc. (= ˚ल) the black berry of the plant Abrus precatorius used as a weight, Mn. viii, 134; Hcat.
कृष्णश mfn. blackish [‘extremely black’, Sāy.] AitBr. v, 14; TāṇḍyaBr.; KātyŚr.; Lāṭy.

कृष्णाय Nom. P. ˚यति, to represent Kṛṣṇa, BhP. x, 30, 15 : Ā. ˚यते, to blacken, Hit.;
to behave like Kṛṣṇa, Vop. xxi, 7.
कृष्णिमन् m. (Pāṇ. vi, 4, 161, Kāś.) black, blackness, Mudr.
कृष्णिय॑ m. N. of a man (protected by the Aśvins), RV. i, 116, 23 and 117, 7.
कृष्णी—√ अस् (Pot. ˚ष्णीस्यात्), to become black, Vop. vii, 82.
कृष्णी—करण n. blackening, Suśr.
कृष्णी—√ कृ to blacken, make black, Vop. vii, 82.
कृष्णी—√ भू to become black, ib.
कृष्णेय m. ‘N. of a man’, m. pl. his descendants, Pravar.
